reconciliation_rule.exact_primary_agreement: Accept the identical decision and selected-ID set.
reconciliation_rule.primary_disagreement: Send only the disputed blinded packet to a third reviewer who cannot see either primary response or sealed identities.
reconciliation_rule.candidate_vote: After third review, retain every candidate selected by at least two of the three reviewers.
reconciliation_rule.resolved_root: RESOLVED only when the reconciled selected-ID set is nonempty.
reconciliation_rule.unresolved_root: An empty reconciled set, two abstain/blocked votes, malformed evidence, or missing review remains UNRESOLVED and stays in the denominator; it is never a negative.
reconciliation_rule.multi_root: If multiple candidates receive two votes, preserve every such root in the fix manifest.
reconciliation_rule.replacement: Never replace a selected advisory or packet after review.
